# WorldBox Modding Docs

> Community-driven WorldBox and NeoModLoader documentation based on real projects, experiments, debugging sessions, and reproducible research.

## Main sections
- Getting Started
- Guides
- API Reference
- Troubleshooting
- Research
- Case Studies
- FAQ
- AI Documentation
- Graveyard of Bad Ideas

## Reliability policy
Documentation should clearly distinguish verified behavior, observed runtime behavior, inference, experimental workarounds, failed approaches, and outdated information.

## Languages
English is the root language. Russian is available under /ru/. Additional languages will be added progressively.
